releaseNotes: Fixes malformed LMS links with repeated http:// or https:// prefixes across Assignments, Teacher updates, Mail box, Topics covered and Resources.
Hyperlinks use their actual destinations, not visible captions. Corrected links are deduplicated and invalid addresses are rejected.
The first school update refreshes cached detail pages and enabled Topics covered weeks once to recover original hyperlink targets, then resumes normal incremental checks.
Old failures for malformed addresses await a real recheck instead of falsely reporting the corrected link as inaccessible. Existing local data and settings are preserved.
